sourceNote: The Tripo P2 panda mesh with its quads (assets/models/panda/README.md). The hand rig assets/models/panda/tripo-hand/panda.blend starts from it in headless Blender with the calls of tools/blender/body_armature.py (design 4.4, "Hand rig").
name: Panda

bind.trunkNote: The trunk of the seated bind sits upright (trunk_turn() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The pelvis turns back until the hip angle opens by open degrees, and each trunk bone takes its share. The values are those of the panda of main (tools/mesh-rigs/panda.json at cbc8db5e4).
bind.bindArmsNote: With straightArms, bindArms.upper_arm sets the bind upper arm, and bindArms.forearm sets only the elbow axis: the cross product of the bind upper arm and this forearm direction (Body.hinges, bind_hinges() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The two directions are those of the panda of main (tools/mesh-rigs/panda.json at cbc8db5e4), so that the elbow axes of the trombone hold stay.
bind.straightArmsNote: The bind keeps the arms of the source straight: the forearm and the paw keep the turn of the upper arm, so that the rest shape holds the bend of no role, and each hold bends the elbow and the wrist from the same shape (the role-neutral bind of design 4.4).
bind.bindSupinationNote: The bind paws take no supination (paw_supination() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), so the bind forearms have no twist.
bind.tailBindNote: The tail is a round bump of the body at the back of the haunch. Its bones keep the directions of the source in the bind.
bind.note: legTurns gives the world turn of each left leg bone from the seated bind to the source: the thigh slopes 25.0 degrees down and 5.0 degrees out, and the shin leans 0.0 degrees forward of vertical, so that most of the thigh lies on the seat (uv run --no-project --with numpy python -I tools/rig/leg_turns.py <config> 25.0 5.0 0.0).

tone.note: No move. The hand route does not read the tone. The color map of the source replaces the face colors in the app.

colors.note: Each face takes the mean sRGB color of the texture at a grid of samples. A face is dark when at least eyeShare of its samples are below dark. A dark face in the eye box is an eye, and a face in the nose box near the nose color is the nose. A palette of palette colors (k-means in Oklab) keeps the colors few.
colors.eyeBoxNote: The eye box holds the two loose eyeballs of the source (x 0.036 to 0.063 on the left, y 0.826 to 0.858, z 0.112 to 0.134). The nose box holds the dark nose (x -0.028 to 0.025, y 0.76 to 0.812, the front at z 0.213).

eyeShell.note: Each eye shell is a fan from the middle of the dark faces of the eye to at most points points of their edge, lifted along the normal of the eye. pnpm body-module drops the fan, and the app puts its pea eye there (design 4.5). The faces of the old eye take the main color of the ring around it.

chair.note: The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail (seat_masks() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The front edge lies seatGap units behind the knee joint of the bind (the property seat of the armature).

armSegments.note: Each upper arm and each forearm has 4 deform segments, and each elbow and wrist a helper bone of this length in units, as on the other bodies.

bodyNote: The facts of the body (BODY_FACTS of tools/body-module.ts) beside the height: the crease angle 180, so that each corner takes the mean normal of the faces at its vertex, as the smooth shading of an FBX viewer shows the source.
eyeSizeNote: The head height H of the body in units, as body-module measures it on the export, before the head size. The hand rig keeps the eyes of the mesh, so it places no pea eye.
chairNote: The seat of the rig in units of this body, as the property seat of the armature of tripo-hand/panda.blend holds it.
rollSplitNote: The simple route splits the roll segments by place (roll_split() of tools/blender/simple_rig.py). The hand rig sets the same split in the exact rows of each arm ring (assets/models/wolf/README.md, "tripo-hand/wolf.blend").
